summary: NORPIPE OIL AS (org. no. 975 871 932) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sola, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-11-13. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 49.500 (Rørtransport); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 296.8 m and net income was NOK 27.2 m. CEO: Lars-Christian Dahl; board chair: Vincent Yoann Lelarge; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
